title: yii2-composer error when using an array for psr-4 autoloading
body:
Hi guys,

We've run into a problem with composer when trying to use an array of strings for namespace location, as per https://getcomposer.org/doc/04-schema.md#autoload. We'd like to use this mechanics to overwrite models defined in a yii2-extension inside of an app application. The relevant section of our composer.json looks like this: 

``` json

 "autoload": {
        "psr-4": {
            "matacms\\post\\": ["frontend/models/overwrites/post/", ""]
        }
    }

```

and the error when doing composer update: 

```
  [ErrorException]                                        
  substr() expects parameter 1 to be string, array given  

Exception trace:
 () at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Util/Filesystem.php:392
 Composer\Util\ErrorHandler::handle() at n/a:n/a
 substr() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Util/Filesystem.php:392
 Composer\Util\Filesystem->isAbsolutePath() at /Users/wichura/Sites/MATA-app/vendor/yiisoft/yii2-composer/Installer.php:125
 yii\composer\Installer->generateDefaultAlias() at /Users/wichura/Sites/MATA-app/vendor/yiisoft/yii2-composer/Installer.php:85
 yii\composer\Installer->addPackage() at /Users/wichura/Sites/MATA-app/vendor/yiisoft/yii2-composer/Installer.php:56
 yii\composer\Installer->update() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Installer/InstallationManager.php:172
 Composer\Installer\InstallationManager->update() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Installer/InstallationManager.php:139
 Composer\Installer\InstallationManager->execute() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Installer.php:578
 Composer\Installer->doInstall() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Installer.php:225
 Composer\Installer->run() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Command/UpdateCommand.php:140
 Composer\Command\UpdateCommand->execute() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/vendor/symfony/console/Symfony/Component/Console/Command/Command.php:253
 Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command->run() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/vendor/symfony/console/Symfony/Component/Console/Application.php:874
 Symfony\Component\Console\Application->doRunCommand() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/vendor/symfony/console/Symfony/Component/Console/Application.php:195
 Symfony\Component\Console\Application->doRun() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Console/Application.php:147
 Composer\Console\Application->doRun() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/vendor/symfony/console/Symfony/Component/Console/Application.php:126
 Symfony\Component\Console\Application->run() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/src/Composer/Console/Application.php:84
 Composer\Console\Application->run() at phar:///usr/local/bin/composer/bin/composer:43

```

Could you please advise if this is a bug? I feel yii2-composer should be a transparent layer on top of composer, but perhaps the design is different? 

Thanks,
Marcin
